title: Placement: GCD and LCM
description: Given two positive integers `a` and `b`, calculate their Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) and Least Common Multiple (LCM). Return a list `[gcd, lcm]`.
constraints:
1 <= a, b <= 10^9
• Time: O(log(min(a, b))) | Space: O(1)
starter_code:
def gcd_lcm(a: int, b: int) -> list[int]:
    pass
solution:
def gcd_lcm(a: int, b: int) -> list[int]:
    import math
    g = math.gcd(a, b)
    l = (a * b) // g
    return [g, l]
explanation: Euclidean algorithm finds GCD in O(log(min(a, b))). LCM is derived via (a * b) // GCD.
